text.p: K-tel International Inc and its subsidiaries, Dominion Entertainment Inc and K-tel Entertainment (UK) Ltd, said Tuesday they resolved a long-standing dispute with Tring International plc.

Under terms of the agreement, Tring has accepted K-tel's exclusive rights to some 2,300 master recordings from the Dominion catalog and has agreed to compensate K-tel for past infringements of a number of recordings.
Tring also entered into a new long-term license arrangement with K-tel for future marketing of those masters throughout Europe.
K-tel, in turn, has accepted that Tring dealt in those recordings in good faith and without any intention to infringe K-tel's rights.
K-tel markets and distributes packaged consumer music and video entertainment
